title: Practice 2: Мне нравится, нужно, надо, можно

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: ___ (кот) было одиннадцать лет, и он уже не соизволил играть в мячики.
exercises.prompt: The cat was eleven years old and no longer deigned to play with balls.
exercises.why: «The person who needs something (or someone) is in the dative case … The logical subject, when used with можно or нельзя, is in the dative case … Нравиться is used with the agent in the Dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 35, 36, 66.
